classification.difficultyReason: Construct the named lines and choose the direction to extend each until it meets its partner, then label the intersection.

spec.description: Four isolated points with positions reconstructed proportionally from the source pixels. A is upper left, B lower left, C above and right of B, and D upper right slightly below A. No connecting lines.
spec.mathematics: The relative point positions determine the intersections of AB with DC, AD with BC, and AC with BD. Coordinates are internal drawing data, not supplied numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Only A, B, C and D are visible in the question.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Trace the four-point diagram to the right carefully into your exercise book.

answer.short: A tracing of the four labelled points in their given relative positions.
answer.worked: Copy the positions of $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$ accurately, keeping the same relative spacing. Use this tracing for parts b–d.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Use your ruler to construct the lines $AB$ and $DC$, and produce them until they intersect at $X$.

answer.short: $X$ is the intersection of $AB$ and $DC$, below $B$ and $C$.
answer.worked: Draw a straight line through $A$ and $B$, extending it beyond $B$. Draw a straight line through $D$ and $C$, extending it beyond $C$. Label their intersection $X$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Use your ruler to construct the lines $AD$ and $BC$, and produce them until they intersect at $Y$.

answer.short: $Y$ is the intersection of $AD$ and $BC$, to the right of $D$.
answer.worked: Draw a straight line through $A$ and $D$, extending it beyond $D$. Draw a straight line through $B$ and $C$, extending it beyond $C$. Label their intersection $Y$.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Use your ruler to construct the lines $AC$ and $BD$, and let them intersect at $Z$.

answer.short: $Z$ is the intersection of $AC$ and $BD$, between the four given points.
answer.worked: Draw the straight line through $A$ and $C$ and the straight line through $B$ and $D$. Label their intersection $Z$.

spec.description: One completed construction containing the original four points, all six requested lines and the three derived intersections. All intersections are calculated from the same coordinate model as the question diagram.
spec.mathematics: X = AB ∩ DC lies below B and C; Y = AD ∩ BC lies to the right of D; Z = AC ∩ BD lies inside quadrilateral ABDC.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; constructed lines and X, Y, Z must remain hidden in the question edition.
